titulo: Guess: Starbucks CEO pay, in years of median pay?
caption:
Guess: Starbucks CEO pay, in years of median pay?

A, B or C? Comment your guess before the answer.

From a Jan 2025 filing. Starbucks proxy statement (DEF 14A), filed Jan 24, 2025: CEO total pay, fiscal 2024: $97,813,843; median employee's annual total pay: $14,674.

The proxy calls the CEO's signing bonus and replacement equity "make whole" awards. It describes the median employee as "a part-time barista in the U.S." and says the median is based on "our global workforce".

The count: $97,813,843 ÷ $14,674 = about 6,665 years, rounded down. The proxy states 6,666 to 1.

No voiceover. Sources below.

Sources
F1: Starbucks proxy statement (DEF 14A), filed Jan 24, 2025 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/829224/000121390025006516/ea0224926-02.htm
